## Episode conclusion (advisory, not acceptance)

Intent: DELIVER
Statement: The sealed rejection is reproducible against the owner databases that actually produced it. The earlier sealed-guard oracle replayed case-3, which already contained a refreshed DELIVER from an earlier run; the rejection receipts were produced from case-1 (WITHOUT) and case-2 (WITH). In those real owner states the prior DELIVER (episode-e7050e9ddf64ccebde7f08f6) is followed by the "Fleet rollout verification" note and names service/test/MIGRATION artifacts, not MAINTENANCE-REVIEW.md. The guard therefore refused twice: "a journal fact was recorded after the DELIVER conclusion", then "the direct commit touches no artifact named by the DELIVER conclusion".

Commit 9c7c3d2 makes the guard reproduce and survive that state without inventing a new judgement. It still refreshes only an EXISTING principal DELIVER.
